definitions.gloss: every time, each time, each occasion
definitions.explanation: On each and every occasion that something happens. Emphasizes consistent repetition across multiple instances.

examples.japanese: {毎回|まいかい}{同|おな}じミスをする。
examples.english: I make the same mistake every time.

examples.japanese: {毎回|まいかい}{遅刻|ちこく}するのはやめてほしい。
examples.english: I wish you would stop being late every time.

examples.japanese: このドラマは{毎回|まいかい}{違|ちが}うゲストが{出演|しゅつえん}するので{飽|あ}きない。
examples.english: This drama features a different guest each episode, so it never gets boring.

notes:
USAGE:
Used adverbially at the beginning of a clause or before the verb. Part of the {毎|まい}〜 series: {毎日|まいにち} (every day), {毎週|まいしゅう} (every week), {毎月|まいつき} (every month), {毎年|まいとし} (every year), {毎回|まいかい} (every time).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いつも: always (broader — covers habitual states, not just repeated events)
- そのたびに: each time (emphasizes the consequence that follows each occurrence)

cross_references.label: each time (also used as business greeting)
